selected_gaps.companion_rationale: architectural_operator_substitution replaces the raw-time input slot with a named monotone local kinetics-clock coordinate τ; structural_prior_encoding acts on that coordinate by constraining its Jacobian to the prescribed phase-kinetic activity and pulling every original electro-thermal-phase derivative through the same map, producing the runnable PINN without changing the physical target.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the most load-bearing method gap because it asks for a representation that directly makes pulse-generated fronts and post-initial high-frequency content easier to express while retaining the coupled electric–Joule–thermal–phase residuals. C12's bijectively equivalent representation-slot substitution fits that demand, while the structural-prior companion prevents a generic learned warp: the clock is tied to phase kinetics, uses an acyclic clock-to-solution graph, and introduces neither a perturbation-coordinate bound, heterogeneous decomposition, curriculum/homotopy, nor a relabeled aggregate-residual score.
